document_completeness.summary: Of 36 files: 4 audited annual English statement sets (FY2022-FY2025) plus 2 Arabic annual statement duplicates (FY2024 6500874e, FY2025 b125279a); 8 annual reports (FY2022-FY2025, English and Arabic, one English 82-page file classed results_announcement); interim files covering Q1 2022 to H1 2026 (English text or image interims, 4 scanned English files with covers read, 8 Arabic duplicates). The inventory misclassified: 5 fully scanned files as scanned_unreadable and 1 as other_no_statements_found (covers show reviewed interim statements), English image-only interims as other/partial (99f50f4f, bc48b8b4, 779cc9ec, bc0dd732), annual reports as partial/results_announcement/annual_report_no_statements for Arabic statement files. Labels: all four English annual files carry the publication-year label; 15 Arabic-language or annual-report files are labelled 2026 although their periods are 2022 to 2025. No wrong-company files found; Arabic files duplicate English periods.

comparative_only: FY2021 (BS, P&L, cash flow columns of the FY2022 file)
absent: everything before 2022 except FY2021 comparative (inventory window starts 2019 Q1: Q1 2019 to FY2021 absent)
company_coverage.inventory_correction: inventory counted 5 complete periods of 30 expected and 13 absent; by page-derived period 18 periods 2022 to H1 2026 have statements with no internal gap (2022|FY was mislabelled 2023|FY). The 2019 to 2021 interims and annuals were not collected. Some of the 18 are present only as scanned covers or image pages whose values were not read.

defects.text: English annual statements carry the publication-year label; Arabic annual statement b125279a is labelled with its fiscal year (2025) so the 2025|FY slot holds FY2024 and FY2025 statements.

Fifteen Arabic-language or annual-report files for 2022 to 2025 periods are labelled 2026 (collector slots 2026|FY x9, 2026|H1 x2, 2026|Q1 x2, 2026|9M x2); counting these would fabricate 2026 coverage.

Fully scanned PDFs (Q1 2022, 9M 2023, Q1 2024, 9M 2024 English; 9M 2024 and Q1 2024 Arabic) are classed scanned_unreadable or other_no_statements_found; image-only statement pages in text PDFs cause partial/other classes for FY, H1 2026, Q1 2026, H1 2024 files.

FY2024 was restated in the FY2025 filing: net income 124,401,607 -> 121,738,036, CFO -87,929,059 -> -181,885,254, CFI -81,785,712 -> 12,170,483. A consumer reading only the FY2024 file gets materially different cash flows from one reading FY2025.
